## Drive Revenue With Our Powerful Sales Tools

Cirrus Insight provides a suite of AI-driven tools to help you book more qualified meetings, execute better meetings, and automatically capture all of your sales activity data.

In the demo below, navigate through the various sales enablement features, designed to enhance and automate your sales process.

### Accelerates Your Sales Funnel

Salesforce Sync

### **Effortlessly Sync All Your Data to Salesforce**

Cirrus Insight removes data entry to sync all of your emails, calendar events, and tasks directly to Salesforce standard and custom objects for standard reporting.

![](https://www.cirrusinsight.com/hs-fs/hubfs/images/sync/Salesforce-sync2.png?width=475&name=Salesforce-sync2.png)

Salesforce Sidebar

### **Easily Manage Salesforce Right from Your Inbox**

The sidebar and mobile interface ensures you’re no more than 1-click away from your next customer workflow. Whether it’s logging an email, task or call in Salesforce, managing your sync settings or sharing your calendar, we’re here to optimize your pipeline.

![](https://www.cirrusinsight.com/hs-fs/hubfs/Cirrus%20Insight%20Salesforce%20sidebar.png?width=449&name=Cirrus%20Insight%20Salesforce%20sidebar.png)

Meeting AI

### **Automate Pre-Meeting Research and Preparation**

Meeting AI automates prospect and customer research to ensure you are prepared and can spend time having high-value interactions that drive closed deals.

![](https://www.cirrusinsight.com/hs-fs/hubfs/meeting-ai-contact.png?width=475&name=meeting-ai-contact.png)

Conversation Intelligence

### **Capture What's Said. Act On What Matters.**

Cirrus listens, learns, and organizes every sales conversation, giving you perfect recall, instant insights, and more time to sell.

![](https://www.cirrusinsight.com/hs-fs/hubfs/conversation-intelligence-transcription-and-coaching.png?width=475&name=conversation-intelligence-transcription-and-coaching.png)

Smart Scheduler

### **Instantly Connect Leads to the Right Person's Calendar**

Smart Scheduler allows you to intelligently match customers with staff in real-time based on personalization criteria, availability, and utilization.

![](https://www.cirrusinsight.com/hs-fs/hubfs/Smart%20Scheduler%20No%20Background.png?width=475&name=Smart%20Scheduler%20No%20Background.png)
